AX Visibility v3 | Unity 6 URP / Render Graph
Import over v1 and accept all replacements. Keep your existing renderer feature and AX component. Old Object Dither selections migrate to Forcefield.
For a new setup add AX Visibility Feature to the camera's Universal Renderer Data and AX Visibility to the player root. Assign the animated SpriteRenderer and the gameplay Camera.
Forcefield renders just the projected bubble rectangle using a cropped projection and a clipped near plane. Shadows are off in the secondary view by default. A dedicated lightweight Universal Renderer can be selected with Renderer Index. Use it if other custom renderer features still dominate the capture cost.
Capture Limit caps the long edge (rounded to a 16-pixel allocation). Start at 320 and resolution 1. Lower the cap if needed. Idle Capture Hz controls updates while camera, sprite and AX are stationary. Moving views refresh immediately. Full Rate refreshes ambient animation every frame.
Require Blocker Collider avoids scene captures in open areas. Select only environment collider layers in Blocker Layers. Leave it off for collider-free waterfalls. Combat Silhouette uses a single sprite draw and no camera capture.
Both reveals draw after URP scene post-processing. AX in the bubble uses the secondary view without depth of field. The bubble also bypasses the main color grade and bloom; lighting can differ across the feather. Lower Field Strength to show more original foreground. Field Sprite Assist adds an unlit pose. Custom later screen effects and final upscaling can still affect the result.
Test at the beam: walk from clear space through the beam and back. Compare face, coat and boots during motion. Compare CPU/GPU frame times at the same position and Game view resolution with the component on and off. No scene benchmark was available during packaging.

Distance controls use Unity world units. Zero for both camera limits gives the previous camera behavior. Set Maximum above Minimum when both are used. Distance Fade Width softens the active boundaries. Both modes skip the reveal outside the window. Forcefield > Keep Near AX preserves foreground surfaces in a band along camera depth in front of AX. Start around 1 to 2 world units. Long furniture crossing the boundary can be partly clipped. Sprite assist is bypassed when Keep Near AX is positive so it cannot paint over nearby furniture. Combat Silhouette still works as a deliberate through-object fallback inside the camera range.
